description: This file provides a client wrapper for interacting with an API in a frontend application. It includes functions for retrieving the API base URL from environment variables, handling fetch requests with retries and timeouts, standardizing error responses, and supporting mock data for development purposes. It also manages authentication tokens via Supabase, and offers features like schema validation and mock endpoint handling for specific routes.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines the API base URL from environment variables, strips trailing slashes for consistency.

methods.name: wait(ms)
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds, used for backoff delays.

methods.name: fetchWithRetry( fetchCall, { retries = 2, backoffBase = 400, timeout = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT } = {} )
methods.description: Performs fetch with automatic retries on network errors and server errors, with exponential backoff.

methods.name: apiRequest( endpoint, method = "GET", opts = {} )
methods.description: Main function for making API requests, including auth token injection, error handling, and optional schema validation.

methods.name: shouldUseMock(endpoint)
methods.description: Determines if mock APIs should be used based on environment variables and endpoint.

methods.name: handleApiError( error, url, method, opts, status = undefined, data = undefined )
methods.description: Standardizes error responses for API call failures.

methods.name: validateJsonSchema(data, schema)
methods.description: Performs basic validation of JSON data against a provided schema.

methods.name: mockApiHandler(endpoint, method, opts)
methods.description: Handles mock API endpoints for development/testing, returning mock data based on route.

ctags.name: handleApiError
ctags.signature: ( error, url, method, opts, status = undefined, data = undefined )
